skill_loaded.description: True only if the transcript shows the agent actually read/invoked the skill under test (e.g. read its SKILL.md, a skill tool call, or clearly followed its specific guidance).

skill_load_evidence.description: Concrete evidence from the transcript for the skill_loaded verdict (quote a tool call, path, or distinctive instruction).

assertions.description: One entry per assertion, in the order given.

evidence.description: Short justification grounded in the transcript or created files.

task_succeeded.description: True if the end goal of the prompt was actually achieved (correct files/outputs exist and are valid).

overall.description: pass = skill used AND task done AND assertions mostly pass; partial = meaningful progress but gaps; fail = skill not used or task not done.

summary.description: 2-4 sentences explaining the verdict and any notable agent behavior.
